label: derivation of sidecar INOTIFY_WATCH_COUNT and WATCH_ESTABLISH_S (rule-based upper bounds), 14 Oct 2026; NOT yet written into sidecar.py
ruling: glitch-06 ruling 3 (14 Oct): derive from the manifest, never transfer .git; every term cited, explicit margin

measurement.scope: measured on the sanitized admitted tree (no .git), athena, pinned watcher image

A_measured_non_git_watches.why: inotifywait -r watch_count on the admitted tree: 61 directories plus the root

B_manifest_git_dirs_other_than_object_fa.why: the export's .git directories except objects/<2 hex>, objects/info and objects/pack (counted in C)

C_full_object_fanout.why: every possible .git/objects/<2 hex> folder (256) plus objects/info and objects/pack, present or not: a take's commits may create any of them

D_fixture_and_working_folders.why: the take's fixture (drive.build_take_fixture: data/staging/<name>/..., gars/projects/<name>/... by kind) and working folders (run_take RUN_TREE_TMP = <run tree>/.tmp) are not enumerated by TakeSpec; 512 is an allowance to be replaced by the stub take's measured fixture count

watch_count.residual: folders the agent creates during a take are added by -r as they appear and are not bounded by this rule; past max_user_watches inotifywait reports an error, which the sidecar reads as a watcher fault (fails closed)

establish_s.rule: bound = (measured establish_s / A) * watch_count bound * safety_factor, rounded up to 0.1 s; must stay below sidecar.ESTABLISH_TIMEOUT_S (30.0)
establish_s.residual: the definition also covers how long -r takes to watch a new folder after its CREATE; that is a stub-take measurement, not derived here
